items.title: Edgar "Sambo" Joseph Interview, 1960-08-07
items.q: And I said, now, Mick, now, I didn't give no credit on that. What they could have done is hire the truck to bring us up there and bring us back down there, we were playing a little longer down there.

ctx.x: That's right. And I said, now, Mick, now, I didn't give no credit on that. What they could have done is hire the truck to bring us up there and bring us back down there, we were playing a little longer down there. And we get down there, we had to play down there in a big open field for them.
All you're playing for the cows and the mules and horses and then dogs. You didn't see nothing in life.
